title: VLA Model
description: Schema for VLA-Tracker model YAML files (data/models/*.yaml)

full_name.description: Full model name or paper title

organization.description: Lab or company that created the model

open_source.description: Whether model weights/code are publicly available

tags.description: Semantic tags for filtering and search

action_space.description: Action space description. Start with 'continuous' or 'discrete', detail after (e.g. 'continuous (SE(3) poses)').

dataset.description: Training data; a string summary or a structured breakdown.

benchmarks.description: Benchmark scores keyed by benchmark name. The named properties are the tracked benchmarks that produce leaderboard rankings; additional blocks are allowed for supplementary results a paper reports (driving suites, ManiSkill, per-paper sim environments) and for keeping baseline, ablation and OOD rows out of the model's own block. Each value is an object with numeric score fields and optional source / date_reported / eval_condition.

additionalProperties.description: One benchmark's results: numeric score fields plus optional source / date_reported / eval_condition / notes. No nested objects — put baselines, ablations and per-setting splits in sibling blocks.

eval_conditions.description: Per-benchmark evaluation conditions. Values are display strings or structured objects (setting / base_model / note); build_leaderboard.py flattens objects for the dashboard.

benchmark_scores.description: Score fields (numeric) + optional metadata (source, date_reported, eval_condition). All numeric values should be 0-100 (percentage).
